steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your educational background and years leading projects. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can verify your qualifications before you enroll in the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led format covers all five process groups and the PMBOK Guide framework. You'll earn your required 35 contact hours in an interactive online setting, flexible for Pensacola's working professionals.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After bootcamp completion, submit your official PMP application directly to PMI, including your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study materials to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center or via online proctoring. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and build your confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to a three-year renewal cycle by earning and reporting Professional Development Units (PDUs). Stay current through continued education, project experience, and community involvement. PMI's maintenance pathway keeps your credential active and demonstrates ongoing competency to employers in your local job market.
